fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: *Maybe you can hear the bunny coming in, or something. A window opening*

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: She comes closer to the bed as Red stirs.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Red begins to wake, he sits up on the bed.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]You’ve been out for quite a while, dear.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Please take it easy and relax all you need.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Why, you’ve found yourself in our quaint little town.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]The parts here are called The Forest of Love.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Oh perfect! Exactly where I want to be!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Oh? You were searching for this place?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]We’re a bit off the beaten path, but you’re here now!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]You’ve even got a few get-well gifts and flowers waiting for ya on the table!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]We don’t often get visitors, especially the uh… passin’ out kind…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]But we do our best to do right by our travelers!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]Actually I was hoping you’d fill us in there!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]Last night as the sun was setting, our resident hawk was doing her patrol - and saw you collapsed!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
I uh… maybe haven’t slept
for a day… or 2…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Come now, you couldn’t have just taken a nap under a tree or something? Sheesh!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]You had us worried sick! Kids these days, I swear.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Ahh nothing to be sorry about dear. I’m just glad you’re OK.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]There’s some food and water I’ve prepared just a bit ago. Please help yourself to them!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I’ll let the others know you’re doing OK, and you can come on out whenever you’re ready.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: *Quick fade to black* (bunny needs to leave)

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: I think I’ve been here before…
